description: Vaarweg - Oevervakken is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Uitgangspunt voor het creëren van deze kaarten is het bepalen van de as van de vaarweg. Deze aslijn is aan de hand van een berekening in ArcGis, nauwkeurig uitgezet. Hierbij is gebruik gemaakt van de oeverlijnen zoals vastgelegd in het huidige areaal GIS bestand. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are vaarroutes, water, waterwegen. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, JSON, PNG, WFS_SRVC, WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
